prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied approved Flow goldfish pixel art. Prepare ONE production fish sprite with genuinely transparent background. Preserve this exact golden orange friendly goldfish design, large shiny black eye, cream belly, stepped dark orange outline, rounded body and flowing fan tail. Right facing side view. Simplify the tiny scale noise into clean pixel clusters on a coherent logical 96x96 grid, nearest-neighbor look, hard stepped pixel edges. Center the complete fish in a square canvas with 12% transparent margin, no cropping. No text, no shadows outside the fish, no decoration. This is a game sprite to be displayed at 100-160px, not a concept poster. Remove ivory background entirely; alpha everywhere outside fish.
